scripts.db:migrate: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @sarh/api exec prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:reset: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @sarh/api exec prisma migrate reset --force
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @sarh/shared run build && pnpm --filter @sarh/api run build && pnpm --filter @sarh/web run build
scripts.db:migrate:dev: dotenv -e .env -- pnpm --filter @sarh/api exec prisma migrate dev
